notes_for_editor: Built year differs between the register description (1938) and its Built field (circa 1939); the event uses 1938 and the record's 1939 is left for the editor. Only one dated staffing mention (1950). The register is the only source on ruins, and it is undated. Listing coordinates (39.21687, -120.85093) differ slightly from the record (39.216355, -120.851216). No visit or access information was found, so no access key.
